answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 47646 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Breaking of Wudhu Question: Does killing ants or any other animals, insects break wudhu? Answer ID: 47646 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1217/1217/M=10/1434) Wudhu does not break by killing ant and other insects as it is not from amongst the things which break wudhu. Wudhu breaks if some impure thing comes out of body or one passes the wind. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
